list: The Twinflame staff's double cast feature does not kill him as expected.

Testing in game reveals that imp defenders permanently stop being aggressive after freeing only one captured impling, only resetting their behaviour upon a server restart. Trapping them to force respawn has no effect on aggression, nor does time elapsed since a server restart, despite statements by Jagex Moderators.
If the growth-time reward would put the cat into the next stage of growth, the cat's growth may sometimes not advance, and instead show a negative time remaining.

If The Feud has been completed, Ali Morrisane should not teleport the player out if he catches them. However, due to the game checking for an impossible state of the quest variable, this does not work, and being seen by Ali Morrisane will always result in the player being teleported out.

Talking to Felkrash with an overgrown cat in the inventory will cause her to train it into a wily cat, which will automatically be set as your follower. Doing so will automatically delete your current follower, such as a kitten.

Occasionally, juvinates may not turn into mist and will instead become invincible. If this happens, leave the general store and try again. Switching to a non silver weapon for a few hits may also work.
There is a bug where it is possible to complete the trek without completing the instance. Just continue the quest as normal.

Some of the broken walls were removed with the technical pre-release of the Sailing skill. After repairing the broken walls that are present, leaving the Colony and returning will cause the walls to break again. This can be done until all five iron sheets have been used, at which point the quest may be continued as normal.

Armod's diary entry "Year 5 of trials, day 93" will reflect the player's gender by referencing they married the king's daughter (if male) or son (if female). Since the Diversity & Inclusion Changes of 9 November 2022, it is now possible to marry the same gender. Armod's diary does not reflect this change, and will show the wrong information if the player chose to marry the same gender.

There is currently a glitch right before the Sigmund fight that can cause the player to lose their pet if they have one out when trying to leave the area. Players are thus advised not to bring a pet during this quest.
If Sigmund is hit while he is swapping prayers, the icon above his head will display the wrong protection prayer.

If While Guthix Sleeps is completed before Animal Magnetism, Aya will replace Turael's role in the quest, with otherwise identical dialogue. However, Aya will refer to herself as a man during the quest rather than a woman.

If you teleport out of the dungeon before the conversation with Osman, you will simply need to talk to the High Priest to finish the quest. Upon travelling back to the dungeon through the maze, Osman will not be there. You will need to talk to Osman in Al Kharid to receive your Keris for free instead.
When the special attack is used against Kephri in teams, the bone dagger must be the first attack before anyone else hits the boss to hit her for a guaranteed hit.
The diving apparatus cannot be properly placed in a player owned ship's cargo hold until the Freeing Pirate Pete subquest of the Recipe for Disaster quest is fully completed.
The fishbowl helmet cannot be properly placed in a player owned ship's cargo hold until the Freeing Pirate Pete subquest of the Recipe for Disaster quest is fully completed.

If the player attempts to set up a cannon without all four necessary parts in their inventory, the chat will show as if the cannon has decayed, even though it has not. Nulodion will not be of help unless the cannon truly decays.
Due to a bug, it is currently impossible to encounter the campsite event.
An instance of accidental variable reuse can sometimes cause the player's Fremennik name to be replaced with an empty string, a character, or even a piece of dialogue from elsewhere in the game.
When attacking Sigmund with the combat style he is praying against, it possible to deal 1 hitpoint of damage to him rather than 0.

If a player teleports while on the "depositing to your bank" part of talking to Advisor Ghrim, after teleporting, the "subject distribution" interface will appear, and players are able to change distribution from their teleport point.

Over the years, there have been occasional reports of the sandwich lady offering seven baguettes in her tray, but no other refreshments. This has been confirmed to be a bug, seemingly caused by the underlying menu failing to set up correctly.
Despite being bolts, kebbit bolts, long kebbit bolts, Sunlight antler bolts, and Moonlight antler bolts cannot be stored in the pouch.
The animation of Rohak making a dwarven rock cake is currently broken- his torso stretches strangely while making it.
The baby black dragon in the Myths' Guild basement lacks the elemental weakness to water spells possessed by those in the Evil Chicken's Lair and Taverley Dungeon.

Mobile players may not be able to click on or move the mirror during this part of the quest. Logging out and back in or unequipping your weapon may temporarily solve it.
The active sigil above a demon's head currently does not correlate with the doubled ash drop. A valid kill for any sigil, not just the active one, will yield double ashes.

The sweeper is intended to clean up alchable items dropped to the floor in the arena, but currently has no effect. It can only see globally visible ground items, but all the items it is programmed to hunt (arena-specific variants like the rune longsword) are untradeable and therefore only visible to the players who dropped them.

*Occasionally Evil Dave will not tell you what he ate, to get around this hold down the space bar when talking with him and it will bring up a list of options, you can then select "because the magic requires it" and be able to proceed.
*There appears to currently be a bug, although rare, where if you teleport outside of the dining hall with a normal cat or a hellcat, it will turn invisible, and you will not be able to see or interact with it. If this happens, simply log out and back in, and you should have your hellcat back. (It will be following you—you won't need a free inventory space.)

There is a bug that may prevent Ultimate Ironmen death pile from appearing should they die in this instance. It is strongly recommended to bring extra supplies or a one-click teleport to prevent this. Bug can also happen to regular players, who may then reclaim items from death
The damage dealt by the lightning ball will not be capped in Normal Mode if there is only one player left alive in a team of multiple people.
You can no longer leave Weiss with Larry's boat. Attempting to do so results in a message saying "I can't reach that!"
When the chest or clam position resets, the arrow sometimes points to a wrong one for a brief moment.

Due to how the Red Axe traders disappear after The Giant Dwarf quest, this causes an issue where the Trade Referee is unable to talk to them while they are present before completion of the quest. This causes their dialogue to be inaccessible.
Despite being fire demons, pyrelords do not have the fiery attribute. It is unknown whether this is intentional.

If the strange old lockpick is in a looting bag and the player dies, the lockpick will remain in the looting bag until it is obtained again, where it will be stored. The only way to retrieve it as an ultimate ironman is to obtain a new looting bag and destroy it in the wilderness, dropping the strange old lockpick to the ground.
When the Colossal Hydra begins its lightning special attack, the player will lose aggression. If the Aggression Timer is yet to run out, the hydra in the area will attack the player.

Attempting to cast Degrime while the player is moving will queue up the action, but never actually cast the spell even once the player comes to a halt, despite repeated attempts yielding the message, . Thus, the player must stop moving and recast Degrime for it to actually trigger.
The cursed banana is known to cause graphical glitches with some equipment.

* Before the player has given the thick dye to Gregg or learned about the intent to paint Ned's door, the player can ask Ned one step too early for his permission to paint the door.
* After the player has given the thick dye to Gregg, Ned will thank the player for painting his door with extra colours and exclaims the door to be missing something, before the door is actually painted.
* Before the player has learned Gregg didn't do the decorations when he got back to Draynor and Ned did this, the player praises Ned for his excellent work on the decorations.
* Immediately after painting Ned's door but before being offered by Gregg to be teleported to Lumbridge, if the player asks the Cook about the Easter event, the player will question prematurely if the eggs the Cook gave to Gregg were rotten ones, in spite of the fact Gregg has not made it to the kitchen, the player hasn't asked the Cook for "fancy eggs", and Gregg has not received any "colourful eggs" from the Cook yet. 
* If the player and Gregg teleport from the Lumber Yard to Draynor together, Thessalia's dialogue will change to tell the player Gregg is at Draynor (as evidently intended). However, if the player skips teleporting with Gregg from the Lumber Yard, travels to Draynor Village manually and talks to Gregg there at this time (as may be unintended), Gregg will not be seen at the Lumber Yard again (as evidently intended), but the script updating Thessalia's dialogue to tell the player Gregg is at Draynor will not trigger, thus her dialogue will continue to incorrectly hint Gregg to be at the Lumber Yard instead of Draynor Village. Thessalia's dialogue will be glitched, but the event can be completed as normal without softlocking. The technical explanation for this is that the player's state of progression of the 2021 Easter event is tracked as an enumerated value, while a hint if the player should go to the Lumber Yard is tracked separately as a boolean value. The event state of progression is observed to control the primary flow of the event and the appearance of Gregg's persona at various places at any time. The hint boolean value is observed to have small adjustments to Gregg's choice of hints at Draynor and Thessalia's choice of the hint of Gregg's next location. These two values can become out of sync with each other. 
 When Thessalia instructs the player's best bet is to talk to the sawmill operator at the Lumber Yard, the event's enumerated state changes to value 79 and the Lumber Yard hint will be enabled (changes to value 1 ). 
 When Gregg will be ready to return to Draynor from the Lumber Yard, the event state's value will be 104 ; the value of the Lumber Yard hint will be unchanged at this time as 1 . Gregg can be found at the Lumber Yard as normal, while his dialogue at Draynor Village will be changed.
 If the player teleports with Gregg as offered, the event's enumerated value will be changed to 105, Gregg will no longer be seen at the Lumber Yard, and the Lumber Yard hint will be disabled (changed to 0 ), and the event stays in sync. After this, talking to Gregg at Draynor Village would then change the value 105 → 125 to progress in the event. 
 However, if Gregg will be ready to return to Draynor and the player doesn't teleport from the Lumberyard to Draynor with Gregg, the event state's value will be 104 as before. Talking to Gregg at Draynor will then change the enumerated value 104 → 125 , which will progress the event and removes Gregg's persona from the Lumber Yard. In this scenario, 104 → 105 → 125 won't be observed and the Lumber Yard value will stay enabled (unchanged as 1 ).
Immobilising, poisoning, or venoming Rex, or using thralls, will not allow completion of the task.
The Keris partisan will fail this challenge. It is unclear why.

Freeing King Awowogei in the Recipe for Disaster sub-quest may sometimes glitch, resulting in Aris telling the player to ask King Awowogei about his favourite food before serving a stuffed snake to Awowogei in the dining hall, even if Awowogei at Marim tells the player they're not interested in talking and the three monkeys in the north-west corner of the temple acknowledge the stuffed snake in the player's inventory to be ready to serve. If the player serves the stuffed snake successfully and receives the sub-quest experience reward with a green quest completion in the Quest List, the Leagues unlocks interface may still indicate freeing Awowogei is incomplete and cost Sage's Renown. (This issue may have been patched on 26 January 2022.)
The League task Complete the Prifddinas Agility Course in 1:10 stops tracking time and may be completed without time limitations if the player logs out during the Prifddinas Agility Course.

Leaving the instance or climbing the next correct tree resolves this.

The Forestry Shop states that both the Forestry and Lumberjack tops and legs provide 0.4% and 0.2% experience boosts, respectively; this is false, as the top provides 0.8% and the legs 0.6%.

If the player has charged the corrupted Tumeken's shadow and adds more charges, uncharging the staff will only return the latest batch of runes — e.g. charging 500 charges then 250 charges will only return 250 charges worth of runes when uncharged.

Currently, if you apply the scroll to one pool in your player-owned house, the appearance of all ornate rejuvenation pools will be changed to the fiery theme. It is unknown whether or not this is a bug, as other appearance scrolls for Garden items only apply to that single instance of that item (e.g. the floor theme).

For unknown reasons, it's possible to hold this clue step at the same time as another elite clue step. Completing this step right after completing a different elite treasure trail and receiving an elite casket will result in this clue completing the treasure trail in 1 step.
When killing him with a Scythe of Vitur, he will not die, you must unequip the Scythe and punch him for the final hit.
Fully uncharging the quiver manually will reset all progress towards blessing.
An incorrect vertex weight can cause some animation stretching on body type B.

The blood jaguar's attacks can become randomly desynced from the animation, leading to their attack coming out 1 tick after the animation plays. To prevent damage from these desynced attacks, wait until the attack animation starts to step away.

If the Hueycoatl heals to full health after a failed attempt, the next person to kill the boss on that world will not receive full drops, with the share allotted to the failed attempt(s) instead being deleted.
Blighted overloads appear on the Grand Exchange in main game worlds.
Using a potion with a digweed (instead of a digweed with a potion) comes up with a chat message stating that you mixed the potion into the potion to improve its quality. (i.e. )
The potion storage currently does not store surge potions alphabetically and seems to slot them between Goading potions and Guthix balances.

Due to the consistent timing for the alembic however, this can only occur if the player had misclicked at least once. When this occurs, the message is displayed instead of  upon first collecting the potion.

When this occurs, the message is displayed instead of  upon first collecting the potion.
The achievement may not always be awarded in some private instances. The cause is unknown.
When the minimap has been minimised the normal special attack graphic is used instead
The crystal currently cannot store a value above 127 for Hitpoints, even if the player is overhealed beyond it. This is due to the value stored by the crystal being represented by 7 bits.
Only 100 is required.

The damage bonus from the Slayer helmet while having this relic currently applies to all combat encounters in the game, such as all enemies in the Theatre of Blood and The Nightmare, despite these not being able to be assigned as a slayer task normally.
Unlike the original Trailblazer variant, this item cannot be used for the Falo the Bard step: A fiery axe of great inferno, when you use it, you'll wonder where the logs go.
The damage and accuracy bonus also function while equipped on F2P worlds, even though the weapon behaves as if the player is unarmed and no double hitsplats occur.
The +10% damage bonus from the Tome of fire is not included when calculating the minimum hit for Searing pages.
An invisible object can be found west of Rellekka, which will block player's movement.
When received from sorting opulent salvage, the collection log entry for this item is not unlocked or incremented.

The functionality that teleports the player to the most-recently visited buoy or mooring point when their boat capsizes is currently not behaving as described by Jagex. Right now, if your boat capsizes, you will return to your post recently visited port.
The in game skill guide incorrectly states that 7 rosewood planks are required to build.

If you mess up on your current bar: getting bar to zero will actually cause it to fail instead of completing (even with correct timing). Instead players should stop one hit before an empty bar and their character will finish it automatically. After this all bars will work normally as long as the bar doesn't reset.
Using the wipe option will allow you to mine infernal shale rocks without a pickaxe. The mining animation shows a bronze pickaxe.

The spellbook interface claims it is a Members-only spell and requires level 42 Magic, but it can be cast at level 0 Magic and on free-to-play worlds by clicking the greyed-out spell icon.
Although the horn of plenty has been described as working on Molch pearls, it cannot be equipped while aerial fishing and does not work from the inventory.
There is currently a bug where if you obtain Dragon Cannonballs for the first time from here, you will not unlock them on the Collection log.

There is a small delay before Doom is truly interrupted, and will continue to charge the bar as it is hit with a melee attack. As a result, it can fire its charge projectile if the bar fully charges after being punished. When this happens before the projectile is fired, the hit will not be nullified correctly as if it wasn't interrupted, hitting the player for the full amount of damage. This is because the attack cannot be nullified before it spawns. If it is interrupted after the projectile spawns, it will correctly nullify the attack as normal. This can still trigger holy water to happen, regardless whether the player was hit or not.

Both the volatile earth and the earthen shield have a small spawn delay that can cause unintended side-effects. If the boss dies while volatile earth are spawning, they fail to despawn correctly. The earthen shield also fails to despawn if it is created after the boss has already been killed.
When attacking a volatile earth, if you trigger a ruby bolt special attack the earthen shield will immediately spawn and despawn in place.
Using an empty spool on an unstrung bow provides no feedback, unlike using a filled spool on a strung bow.
It is possible to obtain the key multiple times (perhaps by completing the trial again after one of the coldfix updates, or by setting a new personal best), but multiple keys have no use.

Due to the 11/26/2025 patch there is a bug that makes the crystal extractor unable to charge after Barracuda Trials. In order to get the crystal extractor to start charging again, deactivate it, then re-activate it.
Cosmetics from the 2024 event do not count as spooky items for the contest.

Logging out or hopping worlds during the cooldown will break the cooldown timer, causing Last Stand to never activate even after three minutes pass. The only fix is to die, which will reset the cooldown timer as normal.
The in game skill guide incorrectly omits the 6 runite bars required to build this facility, and lists 10 cupronickel bars as a requirement.
The first one you create will not give 11 Herblore experience, also Make-All does one too few given the materials.
There are reports that ramming a wall or sailing through a portal can KILL YOU. Hardcores beware.

Note that the level to use the chum stations is not the same as the level required to make them. You must be level 62 to use the chum station and 71 to use the advanced chum station (possibly a bug). This requirement is boostable. Crewmates cannot be assigned to work these stations unless you have the requisite level.
